sections.description_zh: 优先收录中国用户更容易注册、实名、充值或直接体验的平台。
sections.description_en: Services generally easier for users in China to register for and access.

sections.description_zh: 适合测试国际模型、聚合路由、开源模型和海外 AI API。
sections.description_en: International APIs, model routers, open-model platforms, coding tools, and multimodal services.

entries.quota_zh: 新用户注册可获得 2000 万 Tokens 和 120 次图像/视频资源包；官网当前另有邀请好友实名注册得 Tokens 活动，最高可累计领取 2 亿 Tokens 资源包。
entries.quota_en: New users can receive 20 million tokens plus 120 image/video credits. The official site also currently advertises a referral campaign with rewards of up to 200 million tokens in total.

entries.quota_zh: 首次开通后，指定语言模型各提供 100 万 Tokens 免费额度，有效期 3 个月；官网另显示实名新用户可领取 20 元代金券，有效期 1 个月。
entries.quota_en: On first activation, selected language models each include 1 million free tokens valid for 3 months. The official site also shows a RMB 20 coupon for verified new users, valid for 1 month.

entries.quota_zh: 活动截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日：语言模型和多模态理解模型各提供 100 万 Tokens 免费体验额度，有效期 1 年；图像、视频和 3D 模型另有免费次数或积分。
entries.quota_en: Campaign currently runs through December 31, 2026: language and multimodal-understanding models each include 1 million free tokens valid for 1 year; image, video, and 3D models have separate free generations or credits.

entries.quota_zh: 个人体验版限时免费，每月 500 积分；WorkBuddy 与 CodeBuddy 同账号积分共享。通过本清单的邀请链接注册，可额外获得 2000 积分，实际到账与适用范围以邀请页面和账号中心显示为准。
entries.quota_en: The personal trial tier is currently free and includes 500 credits per month. WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy share the same balance. Signing up through this list can grant an additional 2,000 credits; final eligibility is subject to the signup page and account dashboard.

signup.label_zh: 邀请注册（额外 2000 积分）

entries.quota_zh: 体验版为 ¥0；通过本清单的邀请链接注册可领取 2000 Credits，实际到账与适用范围以 Qoder 注册页面和账号中心显示为准。
entries.quota_en: The trial tier is ¥0. Signing up through this list can grant 2,000 credits; final eligibility and credited amount are subject to the Qoder signup page and account dashboard.

entries.quota_zh: 当前产品页显示：Doubao-Seed-2.1-pro、turbo、Evolving 等文本模型各 50 万 Tokens；视频模型各 200 万 Tokens，图像模型各 200 张，语音、向量和联网资源另有免费额度。
entries.quota_en: The current product page lists 500,000 tokens for several text models, 2 million tokens for video models, 200 image generations, plus additional speech, embedding, and web-resource quotas.

entries.quota_zh: 每个火山账号最多创建 1 个免费知识库：免费 30 天，含 100 万 Tokens 模型调用额度，仅对该免费知识库生效，并提供每日 300 次检索。
entries.quota_en: Each Volcengine account can create one free knowledge base for 30 days, including 1 million model-call tokens limited to that knowledge base and 300 retrievals per day.

entries.platform_zh: 阿里云百炼 Model Studio（新加坡）
entries.quota_zh: 首次开通新加坡地域后，按模型自动发放新人免费额度；仅国际部署范围适用，有效期通常为 30～90 天，具体模型额度以控制台为准。
entries.quota_en: First-time activation in the Singapore region automatically grants model-specific free quotas. Only International deployment scope is eligible; validity is generally 30–90 days, with exact quotas shown in the console.

entries.quota_zh: 新用户当前可领取 1000 Credits。Miora 是腾讯推出的全场景创意智能体工作室，可在同一画布生成图片、视频、3D、UI/UX 等多模态资产；后续额度以账号页面为准。
entries.quota_en: New users can currently claim 1,000 credits. Miora is Tencent’s agentic creative studio for producing images, video, 3D, and UI/UX assets on one canvas; future availability is subject to the account page.

entries.quota_zh: Gemini API 提供 Free Tier：部分模型输入和输出 Tokens 免费，并可免费使用 Google AI Studio；有地区、模型和速率限制，免费层内容可能用于改进产品。
entries.quota_en: The Gemini API offers a Free Tier with free input and output tokens for selected models plus free Google AI Studio access. Region, model, and rate limits apply, and free-tier content may be used to improve Google products.

entries.quota_zh: 可使用 `openrouter/free` 免费路由，或选择带 `:free` 后缀的指定模型；免费模型的可用性、速率和延迟可能变化。
entries.quota_en: Use the `openrouter/free` router or a specific model with the `:free` suffix. Free-model availability, rate limits, and latency can change.

entries.quota_zh: 所有 GitHub 账号均包含免费但限速的 GitHub Models 使用量，额度按模型及 Copilot 套餐有所不同，适合原型和实验。
entries.quota_en: All GitHub accounts include free, rate-limited GitHub Models usage. Limits vary by model and Copilot plan and are intended for prototyping and experimentation.

entries.quota_zh: NVIDIA Developer Program 会员可免费使用托管 NIM API 端点进行原型开发，并可下载 NIM 用于开发和测试；不适用于生产部署。
entries.quota_en: NVIDIA Developer Program members receive free access to hosted NIM API endpoints for prototyping and can download NIM for development and testing; this is not a production license.

entries.quota_zh: 每天免费 10,000 Neurons；额度在每日 00:00 UTC 重置，超过后需要升级 Workers Paid 才能继续使用。
entries.quota_en: Includes 10,000 free Neurons per day, resetting at 00:00 UTC. Usage above the allocation requires the Workers Paid plan.

entries.quota_zh: 免费用户每月获得 0.10 美元 Inference Providers Credits；PRO 用户每月 2 美元。额度可能调整。
entries.quota_en: Free users receive $0.10 in monthly Inference Providers credits; PRO users receive $2.00. Credits are subject to change.

entries.quota_zh: 默认启用 Free mode，可创建 API Key 并在 Limits 页面所示限制内使用免费层；适合评估和原型。
entries.quota_en: Free mode is enabled by default, allowing API-key creation and free-tier usage within the limits shown in the console; intended for evaluation and prototyping.

entries.quota_zh: 注册后可创建免费的 Evaluation / Trial API Key；多数 Chat 模型限速 20 次/分钟，Trial Key 通常每月最多 1000 次 API 调用。
entries.quota_en: Registration provides a free evaluation/trial API key. Most Chat models are limited to 20 requests per minute, and trial keys are generally capped at 1,000 API calls per month.
